chunks: ‘Ali ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Mūsā (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from ‘Ali ibn ‘Uqbah, from ‘Ubaydillāh al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

I said, 'We visit the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) two or three times a year.' Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) replied, 'I dislike that you go there frequently. Visit him once a year.' I asked, 'How should I send blessings upon him?' He replied, 'Stand behind him, at his shoulders, then send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and send blessings upon al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.أُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ: I send blessings upon him (ritual salawat distinct from prayer)
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: The Prophet (Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family)
key_terms.عِنْدَ كَتِفَيْهِ: At his shoulders (specific location relative to the grave)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended frequency for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn and how is the ritual blessing performed?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ṣādiq (peace be upon him) advises that visiting the grave of Imām al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) should be done once a year rather than frequently. He also specifies the ritual method for sending blessings (salāt) upon the Imam at his grave: standing behind the grave at the shoulders, sending blessings upon the Prophet first, and then upon the Imam.
